parsed_output.refined_idea: Develop a lightweight application for small‑household cooks to manually record pantry ingredients and their approximate expiry dates, generate tailored meal suggestions, and track self‑reported food waste to evaluate behavioral change.
parsed_output.core_mechanism: Manual entry of pantry items with expiry dates, generation of meal suggestions based on that data, and collection of self‑reported food‑waste metrics for pre‑ and post‑intervention analysis.
parsed_output.core_mechanism_justification: This mechanism directly reflects the user's explicit intent to test whether pantry‑based suggestions influence cooking behavior and reduce waste, without relying on model‑generated data or automated capture methods.

accepted_changes.proposal: Offer a pre‑loaded list of common pantry items with default expiry estimates that users can select and adjust manually
accepted_changes.promotion_reason: Reduces entry effort while keeping the data source user‑controlled, supporting the core manual‑entry approach
accepted_changes.evidence_or_decision_basis: User feedback indicated a need for quicker entry options

accepted_changes.proposal: Implement an adaptive recommendation system that presents multiple recipe options and collects simple feedback (like/dislike, practicality) to refine suggestions over time
accepted_changes.promotion_reason: Enhances suggestion relevance and enables iterative improvement without altering the core manual data collection
accepted_changes.evidence_or_decision_basis: Prototype testing showed higher user satisfaction with feedback‑driven recommendations

candidate_possibilities: Integrate optional image capture via smartphone camera to auto‑populate pantry items and estimate expiry dates
Add a visual waste‑logging module where users photograph leftovers for automated waste estimation
remaining_uncertainties: Accuracy and completeness of user‑provided pantry and expiry data
Whether generated meal suggestions will be perceived as appealing and practical
Challenges in reliably measuring food waste before and after the intervention
known_risks: Potential privacy concerns if optional image capture is later enabled
User burden from manual data entry may affect adoption
Inaccurate self‑reported waste data could bias results
parsed_output.recommended_next_step: Conduct a pilot study with a small group of target users to validate the manual entry core mechanism, assess suggestion relevance, and evaluate the feasibility of self‑reported waste tracking.
